operations.description: Returns a dictionary with two fields ``count`` and ``results``.             The ``count`` field contains the total number of Resources                found without the limit or query parameters having an effect.             The ``results`` field is a list of dictized Resource objects.             The query parameter is a required field. It is a string in                the form ``{field}:{term}`` or a list of strings, each of the             same form. Within each string, ``{field}`` is a field or extra             field on the Resource domain object.
operations.summary: Find resources
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] action resource search [PARAMS] by fields limit offset order query [SCHEMA]
